dct_description_sm: Abstract: Zoning boundaries for unincorporated King County, Washington.

Purpose: This datalayer contains parcel-based zoning polygons and codes within unincorporated areas of King County, based on official zoning ordinance designations. Both current and potential zoning attributes are included. ZONING was originally created from generalized tax parcel mapping done as part of the 1994 King County Comprehensive Plan (see King County, Washington tax parcels). The source coverage layer is intended to always contain the most recent Zoning Changes. [DDES is currently aligning this layer w/ Parcels. Paul McCombs 11/1/2000].
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
